name: Exploring product-truth flows in the Atlas
summary: The user journey through the Atlas /flows view. The bare /flows address opens a finder: search across flow names, step text, input and output field names, AC ids, entities and screens, narrow with facets and counts, share the search by its address, and open a result at its flow or step address. On a flow page the person filters by source, kind and realization without the drawn flow changing, selects a flow, sees who runs each step, opens a step (also with Enter) to inspect its ACs' live status, inputs and outputs, mock records and mockup, and cross-jumps between ACs and flows. Each flow and step has one shareable address and its own tab title; the finder and this address layer are specified, not yet built.

steps.label: Select, drill and breadcrumb push the flow's URL
steps.description: Picking a flow, drilling into a sub-flow or clicking a breadcrumb makes Atlas add a history entry with the target flow's address, while filter changes never add one.

missing_bindings.name: Breadcrumb trail and filters kept with each history entry
missing_bindings.reason: Back and Forward must restore each entry's breadcrumb trail (FlowNavigation pop invariant; nav-drill-and-return-4 returns to Deliver a feature end-to-end > How a ticket is built) and, by the dataset's assumption that the owner has not ruled on, its Source, Kind and Realization filters (nav-filter-replace-6). A canonical URL names one flow, and a fresh load of it shows only that flow with that flow's own filters (FlowRoute invariants), so this state has to travel with the history entry. The design defines no history-state or stored shape for it.

steps.label: Back and Forward move between flows

The page it lands on is the step link documented on openStepLink.

v5: canonical, shareable Atlas flow URLs, from the owner-approved dataset leafcutter/atlas-flows v2 (commit e7c04e5f8) and the mockup leafcutter/atlas-flows-canonical-url (screen atlas-flows-canonical-url, commit 46255a446). Set entities to Flow, FlowRoute, FlowAppearance and FlowNavigation; the steps reach the dataset leafcutter/atlas-flows through the canonical-URL mockup. The flow-level mock_data_ref was left unset so this product-truth commit does not rewrite the back-references of done UXP-520 ACs, whose missing test coverage is ticketed separately. Added steps acStepLink, openByLink, openStepLink, drawerUrl, drawerClose, navPush and backForward, and branches bareFlows, flowNotFound, stepNotFound, legacyRedirect, drawerSwitch and pushFromOpenDrawer, each wired to the mockup screen with one acceptance scenario and empty implements for the business-analyst. Updated the cross step's narrative with today's legacy link form; kept its scenario and its UXP-524 link. Existing step ids, orders, contracts and AC links are unchanged. Approved by the owner at the flow gate on 2026-10-09 with three rulings that keep the URL matching the screen: (1) opening a drawer on bare /flows replaces the URL with the default flow's canonical URL plus ?step=<id>; (2) opening a real step's drawer after 'Step not found' clears the notice and replaces the unknown ?step=; (3) when a Source, Kind or Realization filter change makes a different flow render, the URL is replaced (no new Back entry) with that flow's canonical URL, and a filter change that keeps the flow leaves the URL unchanged. Same day, still v5, the rulings were wired from dataset v3 (uncommitted at the time; FlowNavigation nav-drawer-on-bare-flows-1..3, nav-clear-step-notice-1..4, nav-filter-replace-1..7): the drawerUrl scenario and the drawerUrl, drawerClose, stepNotFound, navPush and backForward narratives now state the rulings; branches stepNoticeCleared (from openStepLink), filterRepicksFlow and filterKeepsFlow (from filter) were added; the history-entry missing binding now also covers filters, which the dataset assumes travel with each entry (not an owner ruling). Readiness, lowered to draft for the gate, is approved again.

v6: the Atlas Flow finder, from the owner-approved dataset leafcutter/atlas-flows v4 (commit bb878207a) and the mockups leafcutter/atlas-flows-finder (new screen atlas-flows-finder) and leafcutter/atlas-flows-canonical-url v2 (commit cd4359cba). The bare /flows address now opens a finder instead of drawing the default entry flow, and a Source, Kind or Realization filter change never swaps the drawn flow but raises an 'Outside the current filters' notice, replacing owner ruling 3 of 2026-10-09; owner ruling 1 (a drawer opened on the bare /flows) has nothing left to act on. Added steps finderOverview, finderSearch, finderFacets, finderUrl, finderResults, openResult (screen atlas-flows-finder), actorBadge and pageTitle, and branches finderNoMatch, finderIoGap, acChipLink, drawerByKey and drawerCloseByKey, each with one acceptance scenario and empty implements for the business-analyst. Rewrote in place, keeping ids, AC links, screens and reads: open (now a flow page), bareFlows (now opens the finder), filterRepicksFlow (now keeps the flow and shows the notice; the id is kept for its AC link and step address), and the drawerUrl and backForward narratives and scenarios, which no longer start from a default flow on the bare /flows. Steps were re-ordered so the finder comes first. Added the illustrative_design contracts finder_query and flow_node, transcribed from the dataset's FlowFinderQuery and FlowNode, with observed examples pointing at their stored records. Entities gain FlowNode and FlowFinderQuery; the flow-level mock_data_ref stays unset so this product-truth change does not rewrite AC back-references. Readiness is lowered to draft for the flow gate.
